diff_summary:

+ pool_max_connections: 20
- keepalive_timeout_ms: 3000
+ keepalive_timeout_ms: 15000
- max_overflow: 30
+ max_overflow: 5

incident.title: payments-api Connection Pool Starvation and Spike in 504 Gateway Timeouts
incident.impact: Payment processing halted for 42 minutes; 1,420 checkout attempts failed with HTTP 504; p99 latency spiked to 6,800ms.
error_logs: ERROR 2026-06-05 19:42:11 payments-api.pool: sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 5 reached, connection timed out, timeout 15.00
FATAL 2026-06-05 19:42:15 payments-api.gateway: [CheckoutGate] upstream payments-api worker exhausted, returning HTTP 504
WARN  2026-06-05 19:43:02 payments-api.health: liveness probe failed: HTTP 503 connection refused
incident.root_cause: Friday evening batch settlement traffic coincided with reduced pool_max_connections (decreased from 50 to 20) and high keepalive_timeout_ms (15s), preventing worker connections from recycling.
incident.fix_steps: Reverted pool_max_connections to 60, decreased keepalive timeout to 3000ms, and performed rolling restart of payments-api pods.
incident.runbook: RB-PAY-04: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion & Recovery

incident.title: checkout-web Widespread HTTP 401 Unauthorized Spike Following Auth JWT Upgrade
incident.impact: Valid logged-in users rejected at checkout page with 'Session Expired'; 3,800 checkout abandonments.
error_logs: WARN 2026-06-19 14:15:33 checkout-web.auth: jwt.exceptions.InvalidAlgorithmError: The specified alg 'RS256' requires strict key format validation in pyjwt>=2.10
ERROR 2026-06-19 14:15:38 checkout-web.session: Failed to decode user session token from Authorization header: verification failed
INFO 2026-06-19 14:15:42 auth-service: Rejected token issue: clock skew tolerance exceeded (0s threshold)
incident.root_cause: auth-service pyjwt dependency upgrade enforced strict asymmetric key formatting and zero leeway on clock skew, rejecting valid JWT tokens issued by older client instances.
incident.fix_steps: Configured jwt.decode leeway=10s and aligned public key PEM header formatting; rolled back auth-service to pyjwt 2.8.0 pending client rollout.
incident.runbook: RB-SEC-09: JWT Token Invalidation & Algorithm Rotation

incident.title: payments-api Connection Pool Starvation and Spike in 504 Gateway Timeouts
incident.impact: Payment processing halted for 42 minutes; 1,420 checkout attempts failed with HTTP 504; p99 latency spiked to 6,800ms.

WARN  2026-06-05 19:43:02 payments-api.health: liveness probe failed: HTTP 503 connection refused
incident.root_cause: Friday evening batch settlement traffic coincided with reduced pool_max_connections (decreased from 50 to 20) and high keepalive_timeout_ms (15s), preventing worker connections from recycling.
incident.fix_steps: Reverted pool_max_connections to 60, decreased keepalive timeout to 3000ms, and performed rolling restart of payments-api pods.
